view_bug_fix.why: Payment has unique_together=('school', 'reference'); creating two split bank-transfer payments with reference='' (empty string is unique-equal) raised IntegrityError: UNIQUE constraint failed: fees_payment.school_id, fees_payment.reference. NULL references are exempt from the constraint, and the model already allows blank=True, null=True. A repeat single bank-transfer checkout for the same school would also collide. Tests 11 passed after the fix.

Contract said allocations[.invoice/.amount] — Allocation.invoice is the Invoice instance, so tests use allocation.invoice.pk (no .invoice_id attribute).
NextTermGroup is not a flat option: individual CheckoutOptions carry .key/.flexible/.amount/.category_id/.invoice_id.
Extras are keyed f'extra:{category_pk}'; tests derive the key from options.extras[0].key where possible.
reconcile_checkout is atomic and idempotent — an already-billed category is never double-billed; ValidationError rolls back line-item mutations.
